info.description:
Frameteller turns spoken stories into storyboards.

REST covers projects, cast approval, panels, edits and selection. Live narration and every
asynchronous result (shots, cast proposals, job progress) travel over the WebSocket
`/ws/projects/{project_id}/session`, documented in `docs/api-events.md`.
info.title: Frameteller API

post.description: Judges skip the per-visitor caps and the waiting room, and draw from a reserved daily budget.

get.description: Stream a stored file. Keys come from the project's *_url fields.

post.description: Start a story. A visitor can start a few a day on the public demo (429 limit_reached).

patch.description: Turn the continuity supervisor on or off for this project. Off: new sheets and renders are not reviewed.

post.description: Approve the reference sheets, or correct descriptions first (those sheets are redrawn, cast stays draft).

delete.description: Remove a character from the cast and its shots. Shots keep their action; their panels are outdated.

patch.description: Rename a character. Its sheet and the cast's approval stand.

post.description: Merge a character into another: its shots show the other, and their panels are redrawn as drafts.
Keep a flagged reference sheet as it is.
"Apply fix" on a flagged reference sheet: redraw it with the supervisor's correction.

Transcribe a spoken edit instruction: a WAV body, mono 16-bit at 16 or 24 kHz, at most 30 s.

Returns the text for the user to check; nothing is edited until they send it to .../panel/edit.
Queue the MP4 animatic. job.updated carries progress; the project's `animatic` holds the result.

get.description: The storyboard sheet: every shot with its panel, framing, action, dialogue and duration.
One job's status, for clients that missed its job.updated events. Keys belong to their project.

delete.description: Delete my recording: every kept narration of this project. A later animatic has no voice track.
Turn the link off. Pages already open stop loading within a minute.

post.description: Turn on the read-only link, unlisted unless `public`. Calling it again keeps the link and sets `public`.
Queue the next revision of shot n's panel. Progress arrives as job.updated events.
Queue an appearance edit ("her coat is red now"); the director routes it, Muse Image redraws.
Save a move, resize or delete of a selected object. A compose_panel job applies it on a clean plate.
"Accept anyway": keep the panel the supervisor flagged; its badge says the user accepted it.
"Apply suggested fix": the supervisor's appearance edit on the current render (422 if it suggested none).
Select the object under a click. Pre-segmented masks answer at once (cached: true); otherwise SAM runs.

get.description: Settings loaded (the container exists) and storage writable. Never calls Meta: probes must be free.
The link preview: the title over the first six panels, 1200x630.
Paused (kill switch) or full for today (global spend cap), and the public-demo limits.
The voices and languages offered. `available` is false when Text-to-Speech is not configured.
One sentence in the voice and language, as WAV. Synthesized once, then kept.
